purpose: Verify immutable upstream source structure and dependency declarations without installing or executing candidate code.
allowed_operations: git init in an ephemeral directory
git fetch the exact public commit with blob filtering and depth one
git show for bounded license and dependency-manifest blobs
write generated JSON and text receipts
prohibited_operations: import candidate Python or JavaScript modules
write outside the GitHub Actions workspace
reported_findings: file, executable, symlink and large-blob counts
package script names and sensitive script keywords
limitations: This is not a complete vulnerability scan.
This is not a complete secret scan because arbitrary candidate blobs are not all downloaded.
A declared dependency is not proven safe by being listed.
A clean static scan does not authorize installation, execution, merge, deployment or credential access.
promotion_rule: A candidate may advance to a candidate-specific sandbox only after this scan passes, its limitations are acknowledged, an independent security review is recorded, and the exact candidate gate is approved.
